methods.label: Apply the defined operation from the inside outward
methods.explanation:
Evaluate the two inner operations first using the given square-and-add rule. The negative inputs also have positive squares:
\[
\begin{aligned}
5\diamond12&=\sqrt{25+144}=13,\\
(-12)\diamond(-5)&=\sqrt{144+25}=13.
\end{aligned}
\]
Now apply the same rule to these two outputs:
\[
13\diamond13=\sqrt{13^2+13^2}
=\sqrt{13^2\cdot2}=\boxed{13\sqrt2}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\text{D}\).
